facts.fact: South Africa's Minister of Home Affairs said in a written reply of 2 April 2026 that the department is strengthening biometric verification by fingerprint and facial recognition matching to find duplicate and fraudulent records in the National Population Register.

South Africa's Minister of Home Affairs said in a written reply of 2 April 2026 that the department is cleansing and strengthening the integrity of the National Population Register, which is being transformed into an intelligent population register.
